stem: While calculating the legal deadline, a prospective review identifies a clinically significant interaction before dispensing. Select all supported actions.

choices.text: At this stage, ignore the alert because the prescription is electronically signed.
Given the described event, delegate final resolution to a cashier.
Under these facts, use professional judgment to evaluate and resolve the issue before dispensing.
On this record, dispense first and perform prospective review next month.
In this setting, communicate with the prescriber or patient when needed to resolve the concern.
